We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (ID 1679747) to the molecule given. The template search gave mapped_rxn and template_id. We need to apply the template to the target molecule (initial_molecule). Use apply_template tool with molecule_smiles and template_id. That will return possible precursors combos. Then format as list of lists of SMILES strings.

Let's call apply_template.
